title: Rotary encoders (quadrature counters)
summary: Count two quadrature encoders (knobs, motor encoders, linear scales) in hardware: never a missed step, position, speed and error counts, with a glitch filter.
wiring: 3.3 V signals; a 5 V encoder needs a divider or a level shifter
a plain knob encoder: common pin to GND, A and B to the pins (the pull-ups are on)
parts: rotary encoder knob (for example KY-040) or a motor with encoder
tested: the self-test passed 8 of 8 checks on the real board (October 2026), with nothing connected.
